story.heading: Twelve owners tried the app for the first time.
story.body: Each walk was a café, a salon or a shop owner opening it cold, with no help.

story.heading: Most reached a real result in under two minutes.
story.body: Three got stuck in the same place. Those are the first cards.

cards.title: Nobody knew what to press after the morning brief
cards.why: 8 of 12 walks stalled here for over a minute. The brief ends with no next step.

cards.title: Invoices say "draft" when they were already sent
cards.why: 4 owners re-sent an invoice because the status never changed after sending.
cards.quote: Did it go? I'll send it again to be safe.

cards.title: Add a dark theme to the schedule
cards.why: Two testers asked for it while checking bookings late at night.

cards.title: The approval card hides the price below the fold on small phones
cards.why: On a 375-wide screen the amount sits under the buttons. 3 testers approved without seeing it.

cards.title: Rename "Your team" to "Staff"
cards.why: One tester expected to find their employees there. The other eleven read it as intended.

cards.title: Let owners import last year's customers from a spreadsheet
cards.why: 5 owners keep their customer list in a spreadsheet and asked how to bring it in.
